Index.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about SmartNotes
Index.faq_1_q: How does real-time voice dictation work?
Index.faq_1_a: When tapping the mic button inside a note, speech is converted into text on the fly in real time without delays.
Index.faq_2_q: What is the difference between PRO and PRO+?
Index.faq_2_a: PRO+ ($3/mo) includes built-in Gemini 3.7 Flash AI without requiring any API keys. PRO ($10 one-time) includes lifetime cloud sync, PDF export, and PIN lock, with the option to bring your own personal API keys.
Index.faq_3_a: Right after payment, an activation code is sent to your email. In the app, open Settings → enter your email or code, and features unlock immediately.
Index.faq_4_a: Yes! All note editing and offline voice recognition work without internet. Network access is only required for AI chat and multi-device sync.
Index.faq_5_q: How many devices can I use with one account?
Index.faq_5_a: You can use your PRO or PRO+ account across up to 3 devices simultaneously with real-time cloud synchronization.
